title: L1 Mobile Device Management Support Engineer
description:
MDM L1 Support Engineer Location: Mumbai Important Hiring Note: Immediate joiners to candidates with a maximum 15-day notice period will be prioritized. We are looking for freshers as well as candidates with at least 6 months of experience . Job Summary The MDM L1 Support Engineer is responsible for providing first-line technical support for enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms. This role involves assisting users with device enrollment, troubleshooting basic issues, and ensuring strict compliance with organizational mobility and security policies. Key Responsibilities User Support & Enrollment: Provide responsive L1 support for MDM platforms (such as Microsoft Intune, VMware Workspace ONE, or AirWatch) and assist users with mobile device enrollment and configuration. Troubleshooting & Compliance: Resolve device compliance errors, application deployment failures, and policy-related issues across diverse platforms. Monitoring & Ticketing: Monitor MDM dashboards and active alerts; efficiently handle incidents and service requests using ticketing systems such as BMC Helix. Escalation Management: Diagnose problems thoroughly and escalate complex technical issues to L2/L3 support teams when necessary. Platform & OS Support: Support Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policies and perform remote troubleshooting for Android, iOS, and iPadOS devices. Documentation & Governance: Maintain accurate documentation, contribute to knowledge base articles, and ensure adherence to corporate security and compliance requirements. Required Skills & Experience Experience: Freshers or candidates with at least 6 months of relevant experience in IT support or mobile device management. Foundational Knowledge: Basic understanding of Mobile Device Management concepts, device enrollment methods, and compliance policies. Platform Familiarity: Exposure to Microsoft Intune, VMware Workspace ONE, or similar enterprise MDM solutions. OS Competency: Familiarity with Android, iOS, and iPadOS device management. Operational Skills: Hands-on experience with ticketing systems along with strong troubleshooting abilities. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills coupled with a customer-centric service approach. Preferred Skills Specialized knowledge of Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune) administration and policies.

title: Senior IOS Developer
description:
Role Overview 
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior iOS Developer to join our mobile engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Swift and iOS application development, with a solid understanding of mobile architecture, performance optimization, and Apples development ecosystem.
You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality iOS applications while collaborating closely with product, design, QA, and backend teams. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance iOS applications using Swift. Build clean, reusable, and maintainable code following industry best practices. Design and implement application architecture using patterns such as MVVM, MVC, VIPER, or Clean Architecture. Work with Swift Concurrency (async/await), GCD, Combine, and other modern iOS technologies. Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using UIKit and/or SwiftUI. Integrate RESTful APIs, third-party SDKs, libraries, and backend services. Optimize application performance, memory usage, battery consumption, and network efficiency. Write unit tests, UI tests, and ensure high code quality and test coverage. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, crashes, and production defects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver features on time. Mentor junior and mid-level developers and contribute to engineering best practices. Stay updated with the latest iOS, Swift, Xcode, and Apple platform technologies. Contribute to CI/CD, App Store releases, and production deployment processes.
 Required Skills 4+ years of professional experience in iOS application development. Strong proficiency in Swift. Strong understanding of iOS SDK, UIKit, SwiftUI, and Foundation frameworks. Experience with modern Swift features including async/await, actors, structured concurrency, and generics. Good understanding of MVVM / Clean Architecture / other scalable architecture patterns. Strong knowledge of memory management, ARC, multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization. Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, URLSession, and networking frameworks. Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills using Xcode Instruments, LLDB, and debugging tools. Experience writing unit and UI tests using XCTest/XCUITest. Familiarity with dependency management tools such as Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods. Experience with App Store Connect, provisioning, certificates, and iOS release processes. Strong understanding of Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and mobile UX principles.

Key Skills: MVVM,Swift UI,iOS,Kotlin,Ktor,Coroutines,Jetpack Compose,Native Android Development
